References define species, aggressive blackened hooked armor, proportions, red/charcoal palette and serious refined angular 2D Runelord cel shading. Match their finish, NOT photorealistic, not cute, not painterly. Broad graphic shadow planes, crisp selected steel edge facets, sparse texture; clean legible silhouette. Red humanoid devil, pointed ears, black horns, amber eyes, normal adult proportions. All limbs, equipment, horns and feet fully inside canvas with margins. SUBJECT: INFERNAL CAPTAIN, recognizable officer above these infantry, not a giant boss. Stern mature devil face with one healed brow scar; swept-back ridged horns. Wider commanding stance facing three-quarter right. Heavy overlapping fang-shaped charcoal plate cuirass, jagged asymmetrical shoulder armor, hooked gauntlets and greaves. A short dark oxblood half-cloak from one shoulder and a small blunt iron command crest behind collar establish rank, no royal gold ornament. Right hand holds a long vicious black iron officer's saber low beside him, blade clearly visible etched with four large glowing orange-red demonic runes; left gauntleted hand gives a sharp forward command gesture. No shield so command pose reads distinctly. Moderate physical build, decisive expression, disciplined officer of infernal footsoldiers.
